{{Top}}
[[File:ApexSociety-TUR.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Collan Eislo, leader of the [[Apex Society]]]]
A '''Sith cult''' or '''Sith sect''' was a cult that would praise, and often practice, the teachings of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] philosophy. Some Sith cults would also worship one or more specific ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and practice his or her teachings, sometimes even with the goal of resurrecting the ancient Sith Lord. Some cults would also involve a degree of fetishism, as they were in possession of [[Sith artifact/Legends|items that once belonged to the Sith Lord in question]] and treated them as relics and sometimes even instruments to gain power.

As with many other types of cults around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Sith cults were often led by one (sometimes more than one) charismatic individual that was strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to inspire faith&mdash;often accompanied by fear&mdash;in his or her followers. However not all Sith cults were Force users, the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] being an example of Sith-worshiping non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].

==History==
[[File:The_Call_of_the_Cult_DaL.png|thumb|left|250px|The gathering of [[Believers]], a Sith cult on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]]]
Sith cults were usually secretive, and not many were known. One of the more influential and powerful was the [[Order of Revan]], a secret society in the resurgent Sith Empire. The cult worshipped the Sith Lord [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and had members in high places in both the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. One of their number, [[Darth Arkous]], was even a member of the Empire's [[Dark Council]].

Early on in [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] apprenticeship to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], he met and helped take down multiple Sith cults, usually ones in the possession of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].

[[Tavion Axmis]]'s [[Disciples of Ragnos]] wreaked havoc around the galaxy during the late [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] until they were destroyed by [[Kyle Katarn]]'s apprentice [[Jaden Korr]] and other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]]. The sinister [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] and the splinter [[Church of the Dark Side]] showed many Sith cult characteristics.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"Sith Cult" is a real life Star Wars Fan-Club. It was founded 1997 under the name "Sith Raise" and was renamed in 2005 to "Sith Cult".
